watch.summary: The streamer praises an egg rolling smoothly along an obstacle course track, only for it to fall off and shatter immediately after his compliments.

beats.what: Streamer states he won't be angry tonight because he likes this egg.
He continues complimenting the egg's smooth roll and jumping skills.
The egg misses the next platform and falls into the abyss.
The streamer screams in absolute despair and rage.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Tonight I'm not gonna be pissed, I like this egg.
watch.why: The instant reversal from claiming he won't get mad while praising the egg to screaming in pure rage creates a classic hubris-then-fail comedic setup.
